page.layout: One printed page: an ornamental division marker with the number (1.) at the head, then a title block and one column of running text. Left margin shows the edge of the neighbouring page (not transcribed). No right margin text. Below the text: gathering signature "B" at centre and catchword "qve" at right.

main_text.head: VITA JOHANNIS MORINI, è Congregatione Oratorii in Francia, Cum Animadversionibus in illius Opera.
main_text.p: BLœsiæ, Galliæ oppido ad Ligerim,natus est Johannes Morinus, sub finem prioris seculi, Parentibus, qvi Religionem, qvam in hisce locis vocant Hugenoticam, profitebantur, in eaqve ab illis educatus, Rupellum,qvæ tunc munitissimum erat Hugenotorum præsidium, missus, ut Literis Humanioribus operam daret; deinde Lugdunum Batavorum, ubi linguam Græcam & Hebræam excoluit,animum-

page.notes: The "(1.)" at the head is an ornamented printed number, copied as page number. The initial "B" is a large initial joined to "Lœsiæ" as "BLœsiæ". The black bar and grey smudges at the top are scan stains and the digitiser's marks, not transcribed. Left-margin fragments ("er.", "s.", "ias", "li.", "x.", etc.) belong to the neighbouring page and are excluded. No doubtful readings on this page.
